notes: The description says this lightsaber combat deck placed 2nd at FreedomCon (the 2001 Decipher World Championship); Martin Akesson was runner-up there.

No separate starting section was posted. The objective deploys Theed Palace Generator, Theed Palace Generator Core and Inner Strength; Heading For The Medical Frigate and An Unusual Amount Of Fear are listed in the 60 and count toward it.
Posted 'qui-gons lightsaber (Destiny 5)' dested Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (Reflections III, destiny 5), not Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine, destiny 1).

Posted 'threepio with this parts showing' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'houjux and out of nowhere' dested Houjix & Out Of Nowhere; 'star destroyer' dested the Light interrupt Star Destroyer!; 'r2 in red 5' dested Artoo-Detoo In Red 5.

Posted 'another pathetic lifeform' and 'your insights serves you well' are listed among the Effects inside the 60, so they are the Coruscant and Death Star II Effects, not the Reflections III Defensive Shields of the same names.
Posted 'sense X2' is left as written: Light Sense has a Premiere (Used) and a Coruscant (Lost) printing, and the post does not say which.
The ten Defensive Shields dested the Reflections III shield printings where an older Effect shares the name.
